knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A solution above the label dilution wastes product, can harm fittings and fixtures, and raises a workplace risk without giving reliable extra disinfection.
The standard calls for replacement when a solution looks visibly dirty, after heavy contamination, and straight after cleaning bodily fluid spills.
The product works during the contact time, so it must remain wet on the surface for the full period the manufacturer sets.

practicalCriteria: Learner measures a dilution from a sample product label with a dispenser, with the result within the label range
Learner states the contact time from the label and demonstrates keeping a test surface wet for that time
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of measuring and timing
stopWorkCriteria: Product has no label or SDS
Concentrate is being mixed without measuring equipment
Staff member is exposed to a splash and eye protection is not available
